name: Crossroads
summary:
Crossroads is an intimate virtual reality film about love, distance, and the quiet moments where life changing decisions are made.

Jaanu and Ram are in a long distance relationship, separated by continents and time zones. After nearly a year apart, they reunite for a candlelight dinner to celebrate Jaanu’s birthday. Ram has flown in from the US, carrying excitement, hope, and plans for the future. Jaanu, equally happy to see him, brings her own dreams, rooted in family, familiarity, and home.
